newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-GULLIT NOT AIMING TO BE BACK THIS SEASON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GULLIT NOT AIMING TO BE BACK THIS SEASON.

text.p: Chelsea's injured player-manager, Ruud Gullit, said on Friday he was not aiming to play in England again this season.
The 34-year-old former Dutch international, who broke his leg in a premier league match against Derby last Saturday, told reporters he would focus his attention on coaching for the next few weeks.
"I'm not aiming to be back for the end of the season," said Gullit, who watched his side training from a clubhouse balcony at their training ground near London's Heathrow airport.
"One good thing is I can focus on my work as a coach," he added.
Gullit's left leg is in plaster and he will walk with crutches for at least three weeks.
Chelsea, favourites to win the English F.A. Cup this season, meet first division Portsmouth in the quarter-finals on Sunday.
